name: Presentations.AI
description:
Presentations.AI turns ideas, briefs, files, or structured outlines into complete, designed presentations on demand. Connect this server and Claude can generate a full slide deck from a topic, transform an article or PDF into a presentation, or build a single slide from a prompt — exporting to PPTX, PDF, image, or shareable web link. Every result returns a document URL the user can open in the Presentations.AI editor to refine.

Use Presentations.AI when you want Claude to create the artifact instead of describing it — board reviews, client pitches, training material, or investor decks.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Presentations.AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Presentations.AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.presentations.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Presentations.AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Presentations.AI provides these MCP tools: create_presentation_from_topic, create_single_slide, create_presentation_from_content, create_presentation_from_file, and check_job_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Presentations.AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Presentations.AI in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Presentations.AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Presentations.AI is developed by Presentations.AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
